chapters.label: Current background
chapters.title: Healthcare is my starting point.
chapters.body: I’m studying at The University of Hong Kong’s Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine, with expected graduation in 2029. My interests include global health, health communication, and practical uses of AI. Alongside my studies, I take part in public-facing projects and international health-sciences collaboration.
chapters.detail: In the U21 Health Sciences Group International Programme 2026, I served as a Group Leader, bringing research, cross-cultural teamwork, and presentations into the same project.
chapters.alt: Zeyi Li at an HKU Medicine outreach activity
chapters.caption: HKU Medicine outreach

chapters.label: Work and contribution
chapters.title: The work happens in the details.
chapters.body: During my June–August 2026 internship with HKU Admissions Office, I supported HKU Academy for the Talented: programme administration, student communication, logistics, and admissions data. In Orbis projects, I worked as Group Leader on community outreach planning.
chapters.detail: Outside the university, I founded a cross-border e-commerce venture, registered a brand, launched an Amazon store for North America, and used sales, traffic, and advertising data to inform decisions.
chapters.caption: Orbis eye-health education materials
chapters.source: Original owner-provided CV; existing case pages. Photograph documents Orbis only, not the admissions internship.

chapters.label: Before university, and still part of my life
chapters.title: Film, language, and the way a story is told.
chapters.body: My interest in cinema, visual art, literature, and traditional theatre began before university. Early explorations of comparative literature and different languages gave me ways to think about stories, images, and cultural context. My earlier personal website was a place to start recording those interests.
chapters.detail: I continue to explore these interests alongside my studies and project work. Bilingual speaking and the China–Latin American literature roundtable have given me opportunities to discuss ideas across languages and cultures.
